from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib
import json
import os
import subprocess
import sys
import time

root = Path.cwd()
out = root / '.devshots/lantern-ward/merged-baseline-diagnosis'
loader = out / 'loader.mjs'
version_controls = '--version-controls' in sys.argv
reload600 = '--v3-reload600' in sys.argv
prefix = 'v3-reload600' if reload600 else 'controls' if version_controls else 'paired'
index_path = out / f'{prefix}-runs.json'
if index_path.exists():
    raise SystemExit(f'Refusing to overwrite {index_path}')
head = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'], text=True).strip()
tree = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD^{tree}'], text=True).strip()
source_diff = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'diff', '--name-status', 'HEAD', '--', 'src', 'scripts'], text=True)
if head != '8cf0034e814ef18af14dcc52f26485e637820e57' or source_diff:
    raise SystemExit(f'Unexpected/dirty production source: {head} {source_diff}')
runs = []

def capture(label, mode, tail, extension):
    stdout_path = out / f'{label}.{extension}'
    stderr_path = out / f'{label}.stderr.log'
    if stdout_path.exists() or stderr_path.exists():
        raise SystemExit(f'Refusing to overwrite capture {label}')
    env = dict(os.environ)
    env['SPACEFACE_BASELINE_DIAG_MODE'] = mode
    argv = ['node', '--import', str(loader), *tail]
    started_utc = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
    started = time.perf_counter()
    result = subprocess.run(argv, env=env, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
    elapsed_ms = (time.perf_counter() - started) * 1000
    stdout_path.write_bytes(result.stdout)
    stderr_path.write_bytes(result.stderr)
    row = {
        'label': label, 'mode': mode, 'argv': argv,
        'environmentOverride': {'SPACEFACE_BASELINE_DIAG_MODE': mode},
        'sourceHead': head, 'sourceTree': tree, 'startedUtc': started_utc,
        'exitCode': result.returncode, 'elapsedWallMs': elapsed_ms,
        'stdoutPath': str(stdout_path.relative_to(root)),
        'stdoutBytes': len(result.stdout), 'stdoutSha256': hashlib.sha256(result.stdout).hexdigest(),
        'stderrPath': str(stderr_path.relative_to(root)),
        'stderrBytes': len(result.stderr), 'stderrSha256': hashlib.sha256(result.stderr).hexdigest(),
    }
    if result.returncode == 0 and extension == 'json':
        parsed = json.loads(result.stdout)
        row['snapshotSha256'] = parsed['sha256']
        row['metaVersion'] = parsed['snapshot']['meta']['version']
        row['motionFrames'] = len(parsed['diagnosticMotionFrames'])
        row['traceRecords'] = len(parsed['trace']['records'])
        row['sourceOverrides'] = parsed['diagnosticSources']['overrides']
    runs.append(row)
    index_path.write_text(json.dumps({'sourceHead': head, 'sourceTree': tree, 'runs': runs}, indent=2) + '\n')
    print(json.dumps(row), flush=True)
    if result.returncode:
        print(result.stderr.decode('utf-8'), flush=True)
        raise SystemExit(result.returncode)

modes = ['version-only'] if version_controls else ['controller', 'current']
for mode in modes:
    for flight, reload_at in ([('v3', '600')] if reload600 else [('v3', '60'), ('legacy', '600')]):
        suffix = '-reload600' if reload600 else ''
        capture(f'{mode}-{flight}{suffix}', mode, [
            'scripts/sf-sim.mjs', 'inspect', '47a', '--seed', '47', '--tick', '720',
            '--inputs', 'test/47a.inputs.json', '--reload-at', reload_at,
            '--flight-system', flight,
        ], 'json')
if not version_controls and not reload600:
    for mode in ['controller', 'current']:
        capture(f'schema-{mode}', mode, ['scripts/generate-save-schema.mjs'], 'md')
print(json.dumps({'complete': True, 'runs': len(runs), 'index': str(index_path.relative_to(root))}), flush=True)
